automaticTeardown.failedStep: Equal dry-run and destroy exact Preview stage
automaticTeardown.diagnostic: jq: parse error: Invalid numeric literal at line 2, column 7

cause.description: The inventory task emitted valid sanitized JSON through Turbo, but Turbo also wrote status text to standard output. The workflow redirected that combined stream to the JSON file and jq rejected the framing before any dry-run or destroy command.
cause.correction: Let the Effect runtime write the encoded inventory directly to TAXKIT_DOCS_DEPLOYMENT_INVENTORY_REPORT while Turbo keeps its status output in the job log. Apply the same contract to Preview, Production and teardown inventory calls.

sanitizedPreflightObservation.interpretation: The retained sanitized inventory contained no pr-59 stage or Worker, but the failed workflow did not complete the repository's formal no-op proof.

reconciliation.diagnostic: The success-only promotion step ran for a failed source workflow and could not find workflow-run-candidate.json.
reconciliation.correction: Run positive promotion only when the source workflow conclusion is success; retain and upload the existing bounded failure receipt otherwise.

nextAction: Merge the focused corrections, manually dispatch reviewed main for closed same-repository PR 59, and require accepted no-op and reconciliation receipts before deleting the old environment.
limitations: This receipt proves automatic job admission, a guarded pre-destroy stop and the retained sanitized preflight observation only.
It does not prove an accepted no-op, successful teardown, Cloudflare mutation, external-state establishment, Production behavior, release or publication.
The old taxkit-docs-preview-teardown environment remains until a corrected run passes.
